0022600020.text: The Miami Heat (1-4, 0-3 at home) host the Indiana Pacers (2-3) in the Heat's sixth game of the season, with Miami 13th in the East and 5th in the Southeast, two games back. Indiana is 10th in the East and 3rd in the Central, two games back, and is on a two-game losing streak. The Pacers will be without Ben Sheppard, Ivica Zubac, Johnny Furphy, T.J. McConnell and Tyrese Haliburton, while Aaron Nesmith, Andrew Nembhard and Obi Toppin are day-to-day with game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Miami lost 1-2 to Indiana in the 2025-26 season series, including a 135-118 loss in Indianapolis on March 29, 2026.
